etymology_story.zh: landau 经法语进入英语，通常认为得名于德国城市兰道。这一名称最初指具有分段折叠车顶的马车，后来也用于采用类似车顶设计的汽车。
etymology_story.en: Landau entered English through French and is generally thought to take its name from the German town of Landau. It first named a carriage with a folding sectional roof and was later applied to motor cars with comparable roof designs.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中视为不可再作有效词缀分析的借词：landau；复数为 landaus。相关形式有 landaulet、landaulette，均指较小的兰道式车辆；它们是历史形成的相关名称，不宜据此自由创造新词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, landau is an unanalyzed loanword; its plural is landaus. Related forms include landaulet and landaulette, names for smaller landau-type vehicles; these are established historical formations rather than models for freely creating new words.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: carriage 泛指马车；barouche 指另一种四轮敞篷马车，通常仅后座上方有折叠车篷；landaulet 指较小的相关车型。这些词均不能在所有语境中替换 landau。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Carriage is the general term for a horse-drawn passenger vehicle; barouche names a different open carriage, usually with a folding hood over the rear seats; landaulet names a smaller related vehicle. None is interchangeable with landau in every context.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 地名变车名：兰道 → 顶篷分两段折叠的马车。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A place name becomes a vehicle name: Landau → a carriage with a two-part folding roof.

pronunciation.note: 重音按所列音标；采用该词条的英语读音。

forms: 基团名称，常作名词修饰语；指多个乙酰基时可用acetyls。
family: acetylate 使乙酰化；acetylation 乙酰化

morphology.text: acet-（乙酸相关词干） + -yl（基团后缀） → acetyl（乙酰基）。

etymology.text: 现代化学英语用acet-与-yl构成名称：前者来自拉丁语acētum（醋），后者最终来自古希腊语hylē（物质）。把它和乙酸中的“乙酰”部分联系起来。

usage_note: 化学术语，常见acetyl group。指CH₃CO—基团；不要与只有CH₃—的methyl混淆。

etymology_story.zh: acetyl 由表示乙酸相关概念的 acet- 与化学基团后缀 -yl 构成；acet- 最终来自拉丁语 acētum，意为“醋”。-yl 的历史来源与希腊语 hylē“物质”有关，后来成为化学基团名称的常用后缀。
etymology_story.en: Acetyl combines acet-, referring to acetic acid and ultimately derived from Latin acētum, meaning vinegar, with the chemical suffix -yl. That suffix has its historical source in Greek hylē, meaning matter, and became a standard element in names of chemical groups.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式：acet-（乙酸相关词干）+ -yl（基团后缀）→ acetyl。主要词族包括 acetylate（使乙酰化）、acetylated（已乙酰化的）、acetylating（正在乙酰化的；乙酰化用的）、acetylation（乙酰化）、deacetylate（使脱乙酰）、deacetylation（脱乙酰化）、acetyltransferase（乙酰基转移酶）和 deacetylase（脱乙酰酶）；常见复合名称包括 acetyl-CoA（乙酰辅酶A）和 acetylcholine（乙酰胆碱）。acetic acid（乙酸）和 acetate（乙酸盐或乙酸酯）属于同源相关词，而非直接由 acetyl 派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: acet- (an acetic-acid-related stem) + -yl (a chemical-group suffix) → acetyl. The principal family includes acetylate, acetylated, acetylating, acetylation, deacetylate, deacetylation, acetyltransferase, and deacetylase; familiar compound names include acetyl-CoA and acetylcholine. Acetic acid and acetate are related through their shared stem rather than directly derived from acetyl.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: ethanoyl（乙酰基）是系统命名中的对应名称；acyl（酰基）是包含乙酰基在内的上位概念；acetate（乙酸根、乙酸盐或乙酸酯）指不同的化学实体，不能与 acetyl 互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Ethanoyl is the corresponding systematic name; acyl is the broader class to which acetyl belongs; acetate refers to an ion, salt, or ester and is not interchangeable with acetyl.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从乙酸 CH₃COOH 去掉 —OH，留下乙酰基 CH₃CO—。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remove —OH from acetic acid, CH₃COOH, and the remaining group is acetyl, CH₃CO—.

etymology_story.zh: kraal 经南部非洲的荷兰语及南非荷兰语使用传统进入英语，源头是葡萄牙语 curral“牲畜围栏”。它与英语 corral 有共同的历史来源，词义由畜栏扩展到与畜栏相联系的围合式聚落。
etymology_story.en: Kraal entered English through the Dutch and Afrikaans linguistic tradition of southern Africa, ultimately from Portuguese curral, meaning a livestock enclosure. It shares a historical source with English corral, and its meaning extended from an animal enclosure to an associated enclosed settlement.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 kraal 是不可再作有效词缀分析的借词；名词直接转用为动词。词形包括 kraals（名词复数或动词第三人称单数）、kraaled（过去式及过去分词）和 kraaling（现在分词或动名词）；常见组合有 cattle kraal（牛栏）和 kraal head（村落首领）。
morphology_enriched.en: Kraal is an unanalyzed loanword in modern English, with a verb formed directly from the noun by conversion. Its forms include kraals, kraaled, and kraaling; established combinations include cattle kraal and kraal head, meaning the head of a settlement.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: pen 是一般性的动物围栏；corral 常指圈养牛马的围栏，尤见于美洲语境；enclosure 强调围起来的空间。kraal 带有鲜明的南部非洲地域背景，并可兼指聚落。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Pen is a general word for an animal enclosure; corral often refers to an enclosure for cattle or horses, especially in the Americas; enclosure emphasizes the bounded space. Kraal has a distinct southern African setting and can also denote a settlement.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“围起来”：围住牲畜是畜栏，围住住房是聚落，把牲畜围进去就是动词。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Keep the idea of enclosing: enclosed animals give the livestock sense, enclosed dwellings give the settlement sense, and enclosing animals gives the verb.

etymology_story.zh: tallboy 是由 tall 和 boy 组成的英语复合词，18世纪已用于指高大的抽屉柜。后来，美国口语又把这一名称用于外形高长、容量较大的饮料罐。

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式：tall（高的）+ boy（男孩；在此为固定名称成分）→ tallboy；复数为 tallboys。家具和饮料罐是同一复合词的不同词义，没有常用的专属派生动词或形容词。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: tall + boy → tallboy; the plural is tallboys. Here boy is part of an established name; the furniture and drink-can meanings are senses of the same compound, which has no common dedicated verb or adjective derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: chest of drawers 泛指抽屉柜；highboy 在美式家具用语中指带高脚的高斗柜，与 tallboy 的家具义接近；tall can 指高罐，接近 tallboy 的饮料罐义，但不一定强调容量较大。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Chest of drawers is the general furniture term; highboy is an American furniture term for a tall chest on legs and is close to the furniture sense of tallboy; tall can is close to the drink-can sense but does not necessarily emphasize greater capacity.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 只抓 tall“高”：抽屉向上叠成高柜，饮料罐向上拉成高罐。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Focus on tall: drawers stacked upward make a tall chest; a drink can stretched upward makes a tallboy.

senses.meaning_zh: 担任钓猎向导或助手；苏格兰地区用法，较少见

etymology_story.zh: gillie 来自苏格兰盖尔语 gille，意为“少年、仆人或侍从”，与爱尔兰语 giolla 同源。英语中的主要词义由侍从收窄为陪同钓鱼、狩猎的助手；ghillie 是另一种常见拼写。
etymology_story.en: Gillie comes from Scottish Gaelic gille, meaning a boy, servant, or attendant, and is cognate with Irish giolla. Its principal English meaning narrowed from an attendant to someone assisting with fishing or hunting; ghillie is an established alternative spelling.

morphology_enriched.zh: gillie 是整体借入的词，现代英语中不应把词尾 -ie 单独解释为英语构词后缀。词形包括 gillies（复数或动词第三人称单数）、gillied（过去式及过去分词）和 gillying（现在分词或动名词）；另一拼写系列为 ghillie、ghillies、ghillied、ghillying。相关复合词包括 gillie suit／ghillie suit（伪装服）和 ghillie brogues（苏格兰传统长系带皮鞋）。
morphology_enriched.en: Gillie is a borrowed whole word; its ending -ie should not be treated as an English derivational suffix here. Inflected forms include gillies, gillied, and gillying; the alternative spelling produces ghillie, ghillies, ghillied, and ghillying. Related compounds include gillie suit or ghillie suit, a camouflage outfit, and ghillie brogues, traditional Scottish leather shoes with long laces.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: guide 强调引路和提供专业指导；attendant 强调陪同服务；gamekeeper 指负责管理猎物及猎场的人。gillie 特指苏格兰钓猎活动中的向导或助手，不一定承担猎场管理职责。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Guide emphasizes direction and expert advice; attendant emphasizes accompanying and assisting someone; gamekeeper refers to someone responsible for game animals and their habitat. Gillie specifically denotes a Scottish fishing or hunting assistant and does not necessarily imply responsibility for managing an estate.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“侍从”记到“钓猎助手”：陪你下河、上山的人就是 gillie。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Move from attendant to outdoor assistant: the person helping you on a Scottish river or hillside is a gillie.

senses.meaning_zh: 歌利亚；《圣经》中被大卫击败的非利士勇士，首字母大写
senses.meaning_en: Goliath, the Philistine warrior defeated by David in the Bible; written with a capital G.
senses.english_definition: Goliath is the exceptionally large Philistine warrior whom David defeats in a biblical story.
senses.collocation_en: David and Goliath; the story of Goliath
senses.collocation_zh: 大卫与歌利亚；歌利亚的故事

senses.sentence_zh: 在《圣经》的故事中，大卫用投石索和一块石头击败了歌利亚。

etymology_story.zh: 源自《圣经》人物名 Goliath，经教会拉丁语和希腊语传自希伯来语 Golyat；这个名字的更早词源并不确定。由于歌利亚体形巨大、武力强大，英语后来把他的名字用作普通名词，指庞大或强势的对象。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from the biblical name Goliath, transmitted through ecclesiastical Latin and Greek from Hebrew Golyat; the name's deeper origin is uncertain. The warrior's extraordinary size and strength led to its use as a common noun for a massive or powerful person or organization.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为不可进一步分析的词基：Goliath（人名）→ goliath（普通名词，专名普通化）；复数为 goliaths。没有常用的前后缀派生词族；Goliath-sized（歌利亚般巨大的）是临时复合形式，goliath frog（巨蛙）是名词组合。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, the word is an unanalyzable base: Goliath, a personal name, becomes goliath, a common noun, through commonization; its plural is goliaths. It has no established productive family of affixed derivatives; Goliath-sized is a transparent compound, and goliath frog is a noun combination.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: giant（巨人；巨头）适用范围最广；titan（巨擘）更突出成就、影响力或卓越地位；behemoth（庞然大物）强调体量巨大，有时暗示笨重。goliath 常让人联想到强弱悬殊的竞争。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Giant is the broadest term for exceptional size or power; titan emphasizes achievement, influence, or eminence; behemoth stresses enormous bulk and can suggest unwieldiness. Goliath often evokes an unequal contest against a much smaller opponent.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“大卫对歌利亚”记住：小者挑战庞大强敌，强敌就是 goliath。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture David facing Goliath: the overwhelmingly large, powerful opponent is the goliath.

etymology.text: 17世纪经法语jonquille借入英语，来自西班牙语junquillo，它是junco（灯心草）的指小形式。细长如灯心草的叶子是记忆线索。

senses.meaning_zh: 长寿花水仙；黄水仙，尤指具有细长叶片和芳香黄色花朵的水仙

senses.collocation_en: jonquil bulbs; fragrant jonquils
senses.collocation_zh: 黄水仙鳞茎；芳香的黄水仙

etymology_story.zh: 17世纪经法语 jonquille 借入英语，法语词来自西班牙语 junquillo，即 junco（灯心草）的指小形式，后者可追溯至拉丁语 iuncus。这个名称着眼于植物如灯心草般细长的叶片，后来又用于表示花朵的黄色。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed jonquil in the seventeenth century from French jonquille, from Spanish junquillo, a diminutive of junco, meaning 'rush,' ultimately from Latin iuncus. The name refers to the plant's narrow, rushlike leaves and later also became a term for its yellow color.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 jonquil 是整体借入的简单词，不能按英语词缀拆分；复数为 jonquils。没有常用的前后缀派生词族；jonquil yellow（水仙黄）和 jonquil-colored（水仙黄色的）属于组合形式，西班牙语历史指小后缀不能当作现代英语构词成分。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, jonquil is a simple borrowed word with no productive English prefix or suffix; its plural is jonquils. It has no common affixed derivative family; jonquil yellow and jonquil-colored are combinations, while the historical Spanish diminutive is not a modern English morphological component.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: daffodil（水仙，尤指黄花水仙）是日常语言中更宽泛的名称；narcissus（水仙属植物）范围更广，也用于植物学语境；pale yellow（淡黄色）只对应颜色义。严格说来，jonquil 通常指特定类型的水仙，不能与所有 daffodils 完全互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Daffodil is a broader everyday name for these familiar spring flowers; narcissus covers the wider botanical group; pale yellow corresponds only to the color sense. Strictly, jonquil denotes a particular kind of narcissus and is not interchangeable with every use of daffodil.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 细叶像灯心草，黄花有芳香：由“灯心草般的叶”锁定 jonquil。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Rushlike leaves and fragrant yellow flowers: the leaf shape explains the name jonquil.

etymology_story.zh: 由英语 home 和 base 组成；home 源自古英语 hām，base 经法语追溯至拉丁语 basis 和希腊语 basis，表示底部或基础。这个组合既可表示棒球的本垒，也可表示活动所依托或返回的基地；普通英语通常分写为 home base。
etymology_story.en: The expression combines home, from Old English hām, with base, transmitted through French from Latin basis and Greek basis, meaning a foundation or support. It denotes both the home position in baseball and a place from which activities are organized or to which someone returns; ordinary English normally writes it as home base.

morphology_enriched.zh: home（家；本部）+ base（基地）→ home base（名词复合词）；homebase 是可见但不如分写形式通行的连写变体。复数通常为 home bases；相关形式有 home-based（以家或某地为基地的）、home-based business（家庭经营企业）和 home-base advantage（主场优势，依语境使用）；这些是相关组合，并非全都由连写形式直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Home + base forms the noun compound home base; homebase is an attested closed variant, but the spaced form is more usual. The normal plural is home bases; related combinations include home-based, home-based business, and the context-dependent expression home-base advantage. These are related formations rather than derivatives of the closed spelling.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: headquarters（总部）强调组织的管理或指挥中心；base of operations（行动基地）强调工作或行动的出发点；home plate（本垒）只对应棒球义。home base 还可指个人长期依托和经常返回的城市或住所。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Headquarters emphasizes an organization's management or command center; base of operations emphasizes where work or activities are conducted from; home plate corresponds specifically to the baseball sense. Home base can also be an individual's usual city or residence.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: home + base：出发时依托、结束后返回的“家基地”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Home + base: the place you operate from and return to.

etymology_story.zh: 来自古希腊地名 Κῶς，通常转写为 Kōs；现代希腊语写作 Κως。英语使用 Kos，也保留传统拼写 Cos；这个地名更早的来源不确定，不宜强行解释为某个现代词根。
etymology_story.en: Kos continues the ancient Greek place-name Κῶς, usually transliterated Kōs; its modern Greek spelling is Κως. English uses Kos alongside the traditional spelling Cos, while the name's deeper origin is uncertain.

morphology_enriched.zh: Kos 是不可按现代英语词缀拆分的专有地名；Cos 是传统拼写。相关词 Coan 可作形容词，意为“科斯岛的”，也可作名词，意为“科斯岛人”；它沿用古典地名词干，并非将 Kos 机械拆成现代英语前缀和词根。
morphology_enriched.en: Kos is a proper place-name with no modern English prefix-and-root breakdown; Cos is a traditional spelling. The related form Coan functions as an adjective meaning 'of Kos' and as a noun meaning 'a person from Kos'; it reflects a classical place-name stem rather than a productive segmentation of Kos.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Cos 是同一地名的传统英语拼写，Κως 是现代希腊语原文，二者属于名称变体而非普通近义词。Kos Town 专指岛上的主要城镇，the island of Kos 则明确指整座岛。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Cos is a traditional English spelling, and Κως is the modern Greek form; these are name variants rather than ordinary synonyms. Kos Town specifically identifies the principal settlement, whereas the island of Kos explicitly refers to the whole island.

senses.meaning_en: A spell of trivial or rambling talk; a less common British informal use.

senses.collocation_en: have a witter; a little witter

etymology_story.zh: 源自英语方言中的 whitter，意为闲扯或嘟囔，通常被认为带有拟声性质，后来进入英式非正式用语。可以用 twitter 所表示的细碎连续声响帮助联想，但这种相似性不等于已经证实二者存在直接派生关系。
etymology_story.en: Witter comes from dialectal whitter, meaning to chatter or mutter, and is generally regarded as imitative in origin; it later entered informal British usage. Its resemblance to twitter provides a useful sound association, but does not establish direct derivation from that word.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中以 witter 为整体词基，不拆作 wit + -er；动词变化为 witters、wittered、wittering。witter + -er → witterer（絮叨的人），复数为 witterers；wittering 和 witterings 也可表示絮叨或琐碎言论，名词 witter 则与动词同形。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats witter as a whole base, not as wit + -er; its verb forms are witters, wittered, and wittering. Adding -er gives witterer, plural witterers; wittering and witterings can denote trivial talk or remarks, while the noun witter has the same form as the verb.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: chatter（闲聊；叽叽喳喳地说）常强调轻快或连续说话，未必贬义；prattle（絮叨）常暗示内容幼稚或空泛；ramble（漫无边际地说）强调缺乏条理。witter 尤其突出琐碎话题令人厌烦地持续。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Chatter suggests light or continuous talk and need not be negative; prattle often suggests childish or empty talk; ramble emphasizes a lack of direction or organization. Witter particularly suggests an irritating flow of talk about trivial matters.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 联想细碎声音一直响：小事说个不停，就是 witter；这是声音助记，不是词根拆解。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Imagine a stream of tiny, repetitive sounds becoming endless trivial talk: witter. This is a sound-based memory aid, not a root analysis.

etymology_story.zh: BAFTA由British Academy of Film and Television Arts这一机构名称中的主要词语首字母组成，读作一个词。该缩略名称也通过转喻指该机构颁发的单个奖项。
etymology_story.en: BAFTA is an acronym formed from the principal words in British Academy of Film and Television Arts and pronounced as a word. By metonymy, the organization's name also came to denote an individual award that it presents.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式：British + Academy + Film + Television + Arts的首字母 → BAFTA；of和and不计入。表示奖项时是可数名词，复数为BAFTAs；BAFTA-winning（获得该奖的）和BAFTA-nominated（获该奖提名的）是常见复合修饰语；没有固定的常用后缀派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Formation: the initials of British + Academy + Film + Television + Arts → BAFTA; of and and are omitted. As an award name, it is countable, with the plural BAFTAs; BAFTA-winning and BAFTA-nominated are common compound modifiers. It has no established family of common suffixal derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 无严格同义词。the Academy在语境明确时可指该机构，但脱离语境容易与其他学院混淆；a BAFTA award明确指奖项；an Oscar指美国电影艺术与科学学院颁发的奥斯卡奖，是相关奖项而非同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no exact synonym. The Academy can refer to the organization when the context is clear but is otherwise ambiguous; a BAFTA award explicitly denotes the prize; an Oscar is a related award presented by the US Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, not a synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.en: Five key initials name the academy; the academy's name also names its prize.

etymology_story.zh: Beefeater字面意思是“吃牛肉的人”，后来成为伦敦塔守卫等皇家卫士的传统昵称；昵称的确切起源并无定论，常见解释将它与卫士获得的牛肉口粮联系起来。金酒品牌沿用了这一守卫形象及其名称。
etymology_story.en: Beefeater literally means a person who eats beef and became a traditional nickname for royal guards, especially the Tower's warders; its precise origin is uncertain, although a familiar explanation connects it with their beef rations. The gin brand adopted the warder's name and image.

morphology_enriched.zh: 构词公式：beef（牛肉）+ eater（吃某物的人），其中eater = eat + -er。守卫义的复数为Beefeaters；品牌名通常不变。组成词的相关词形有eat、eats、ate、eaten、eating和eater；Beefeater本身没有固定的常用派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Structure: beef + eater, with eater formed from eat + the agent suffix -er. The plural for the warders is Beefeaters; the brand name normally remains unchanged. Related forms of the verbal base are eat, eats, ate, eaten, eating, and eater; Beefeater itself has no established family of common derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Yeoman Warder是伦敦塔守卫的正式称呼；Tower warder是描述性称呼；Yeoman of the Guard指另一支皇家卫队的成员，虽然也可能被俗称为Beefeater，但不能与伦敦塔守卫的正式身份混为一谈。品牌义无严格同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Yeoman Warder is the official title of a Tower warder; Tower warder is a descriptive equivalent; a Yeoman of the Guard belongs to a separate royal bodyguard, whose members may also be nicknamed Beefeaters but have a different official identity. The brand name has no exact synonym.

etymology_story.zh: 该词来自中古英语selfegge等形式，由self（自身）与egge（边，现代edge）组成，与中古荷兰语的对应复合词有关。原义可理解为布料“自身形成的边”，后来固定指织造时形成的牢固布边。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from Middle English forms such as selfegge, combining self with egge, the ancestor of edge, and is associated with a corresponding Middle Dutch compound. Its literal idea of a fabric's own edge developed into the established textile sense of a securely woven side edge.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语通常将selvedge视为整词；self + edge是历史构词分析，不能直接解释其现代拼写。美式拼写变体为selvage；复数为selvedges或selvages；形容词selvedged或selvaged表示“有织边的”；selvedge denim属于名词作定语。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, selvedge is generally treated as a whole word; self + edge is a historical analysis rather than a transparent account of its present spelling. Selvage is an American spelling variant; plurals are selvedges and selvages; selvedged and selvaged mean having a selvedge. In selvedge denim, the noun functions attributively.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: woven edge强调织造形成的边，最接近本义；finished edge泛指经过处理的边，不限于织边；hem指将布边折回缝成的折边，与织造时形成的selvedge不同。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Woven edge is the closest descriptive equivalent; finished edge is broader and includes edges finished by other methods; a hem is made by folding and sewing an edge, whereas a selvedge is formed during weaving.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: self + edge：布在织造时“自带的边”，帮助挡住散线。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Self + edge: the fabric's built-in woven edge helps hold its threads in place.

etymology_story.zh: 独立使用的neuro是neurologist、neurology等词在口语或行业交流中的截短形式，具体所指依赖语境。这些词中的neuro-最终来自古希腊语neuron，原有“筋腱；神经”等含义，后来成为神经科学术语的常用构词成分。
etymology_story.en: Independent neuro arose as an informal or professional clipping of words such as neurologist and neurology, with its reference determined by context. Their combining form neuro- ultimately comes from Ancient Greek neuron, meaning sinew or nerve, and became widely used in scientific terminology.

morphology_enriched.zh: 独立词neuro属于截短词；neuro-（神经；神经系统）则是能产的古典构词成分，不能与独立名词完全等同。主要相关词族包括neurology（神经病学）、neurologist（神经科医生）、neurologic/neurological（神经系统的）、neurologically（在神经学方面）、neuron（神经元）、neuronal（神经元的）、neural（神经的）、neurally（在神经层面）、neuroscience（神经科学）、neuroscientist（神经科学家）、neuroscientific（神经科学的）、neurosurgery（神经外科）、neurosurgeon（神经外科医生）、neurosurgical（神经外科的）、neuropathy（神经病变）和neuropathic（神经病变的）；该构词系列开放，无法列成封闭的完整清单。
morphology_enriched.en: Independent neuro is a clipping; neuro-, meaning nerve or nervous system, is a productive classical combining form and is distinct from the independent noun. Principal related forms include neurology, neurologist, neurologic/neurological, neurologically, neuron, neuronal, neural, neurally, neuroscience, neuroscientist, neuroscientific, neurosurgery, neurosurgeon, neurosurgical, neuropathy, and neuropathic. This productive formation pattern has an open-ended family rather than a finite exhaustive list.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: neurologist是医生义的正式全称；neurology是学科或科室义的正式全称；nerve specialist是较通俗的描述，但专业范围不如neurologist明确。neuro的准确展开形式必须由语境判断。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Neurologist is the formal full term for the doctor; neurology is the formal term for the discipline or service; nerve specialist is a plain-language description with a less precise professional scope. Context determines which full term neuro represents.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 看到neuro，先想到“神经系统”，再用语境判断是在说医生、学科还是科室。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Let neuro trigger nervous system, then use context to identify the doctor, subject, or service.

etymology_story.zh: Metallica于1981年被采用为乐队名；它原本是Ron Quintana为乐迷刊物考虑的候选名称之一，后来被Lars Ulrich用于乐队。该名称使人联想到metal音乐，但不宜将其当作具有固定古典词根释义的普通英语词。
etymology_story.en: Metallica was adopted as the band's name in 1981 after appearing among names Ron Quintana was considering for a fan magazine; Lars Ulrich then used it for the band. The name evokes metal music but should not be treated as an ordinary English word with a fixed classical-root interpretation.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中将Metallica作为完整专名处理，不宜硬拆成metal + -lic + -a。它没有固定的常用派生词族；Metallica-esque可由专名加表示“具有……风格”的后缀-esque临时构成，意思是“具有金属乐队风格的”，但不属于必须掌握的固定词形。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats Metallica as a complete proper name rather than transparently dividing it into metal + -lic + -a. It has no established family of common derivatives; Metallica-esque can be formed productively with the style suffix -esque to mean resembling Metallica's style, but it is an occasional formation rather than a core established derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 无严格同义词。the band只能在前文明确指向Metallica时替代；heavy metal band是上位类别，范围更广；thrash metal band强调乐队与激流金属的联系，也不是专名的同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: There is no exact synonym. The band can substitute only when Metallica is already the clear referent; heavy metal band is a broader category; thrash metal band emphasizes the group's association with that genre and is not a synonym for its name.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 用metal音乐联想到Metallica这个乐队名；这是专名联想，不是词根拆解。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect metal music with the band name Metallica; use the association as a memory cue, not a root analysis.

etymology_story.zh: 直接来自拉丁语 vēritās（真理、真实），由 vērus（真实的）与抽象名词后缀 -itās 构成。英语主要在格言、校训及学术表达中保留其拉丁语形式；verity 与它同源。
etymology_story.en: The word comes directly from Latin vēritās, meaning truth or reality, formed from vērus, meaning true, and the abstract noun suffix -itās. English chiefly preserves the Latin form in mottoes and learned expressions; verity shares the same origin.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中通常作为完整的拉丁语借用形式处理，不宜机械拆成英语词根和词缀。历史结构为拉丁语 vēr-（真实）+ -itās（抽象名词后缀）；英语同源词包括 verity（真理、真实）、veritable（名副其实的）、veritably（确实地）、verify（核实）、verification（核实）、verifiable（可核实的）和 verifier（核验者或核验工具），这些并非由现代英语 veritas 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, veritas is normally treated as a complete Latin borrowing rather than a productive English root-and-affix formation. Its historical structure is Latin vēr- 'true' + -itās, an abstract noun suffix; related English words include verity, veritable, veritably, verify, verification, verifiable, and verifier, but these are not direct modern English derivatives of veritas.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: truth（真理、事实）是日常通用词；verity（真实、真理）具有文学或正式色彩，也可指一条公认的真理；veracity（真实性、诚实）侧重陈述是否真实或说话者是否诚实。veritas 则明显保留拉丁语和格言色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Truth is the ordinary general term; verity is literary or formal and can denote an established truth; veracity concerns the truthfulness of a statement or speaker. Veritas retains a distinctly Latin, motto-like character.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把历史词根 ver- 与“真实”相连：veritas 就是校训中庄重的“真理”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect the historical root ver- with 'true': veritas is the solemn 'truth' proclaimed in a motto.

etymology_story.zh: 英语借自泰语 wat（วัด，佛寺）；相关词也见于高棉语等区域语言。它通常被追溯至梵语 vāṭa（围合的场地、院落），体现了从围合空间到寺院场所的意义发展。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed wat from Thai wat (วัด), meaning a Buddhist temple; related forms occur in Khmer and other regional languages. It is commonly traced to Sanskrit vāṭa, an enclosure or enclosed ground, reflecting a development from an enclosed space to a religious compound.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中为不可再分析的借词：wat；规则复数为 wats。没有常用的英语派生词；wat complex（佛寺建筑群）和 wat compound（佛寺院区）是名词组合，并非词缀派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Wat is an unanalyzable borrowing in modern English, with the regular plural wats. It has no common English derivatives; wat complex and wat compound are noun combinations rather than affix-based derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: temple（寺庙）是最宽泛的宗教建筑名称；monastery（修道院、僧院）强调僧侣共同生活的机构；pagoda（佛塔）通常指塔式宗教建筑，不能准确替代整个寺院建筑群。wat 则带有明确的东南亚佛教文化背景。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Temple is the broad term for a religious building; monastery emphasizes a community and residence of monks; pagoda usually denotes a religious tower rather than an entire temple complex. Wat specifically evokes a Southeast Asian Buddhist setting.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 从“围合的院落”想到“有庭院和殿堂的东南亚佛寺”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture an enclosed courtyard containing Buddhist halls: that temple compound is a wat.

etymology_story.zh: 经法语进入中古英语，最终来自拉丁语 glēba 或 glaeba（土块、土地）。这个表示泥土或土地的词后来在教会语境中专指为圣职提供收入的地产。
etymology_story.en: The word entered Middle English through French and ultimately comes from Latin glēba or glaeba, meaning a clod of earth or land. In church usage, this general idea of land narrowed to property providing income for an ecclesiastical living.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中为单纯词 glebe；表示不同地块或地产时可用复数 glebes。罕见派生词有 glebe + -less → glebeless（没有圣职地产的）和 glebe + -y → gleby（多土块的、与土地有关的）；常见相关组合有 glebe land（圣职地产）和 glebe house（与圣职地产相关的牧师住宅）。
morphology_enriched.en: Glebe is a simple word in modern English; the plural glebes can refer to separate holdings. Rare derivatives include glebe + -less → glebeless, meaning without glebe, and glebe + -y → gleby, meaning cloddy or relating to the soil; associated compounds include glebe land and glebe house.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: church land（教会土地）涵盖教会持有的各种土地；ecclesiastical property（教会财产）还可包括建筑等非土地资产；benefice（圣职及其收益权）指附带收入的教会职位或权益。glebe 特指为圣职提供收益的土地本身。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Church land covers land held by a church generally; ecclesiastical property also includes buildings and other assets; a benefice is a church office or entitlement carrying income. Glebe specifically identifies the land that provides support.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 土块 → 一块地产 → 用土地收益供养牧师。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A clod becomes a plot of land; the land's income supports the priest.

etymology_story.zh: 名词 flexi 是 flexitime（弹性工作时间制）的非正式缩略形式；形容词用法则与 flexible（灵活的）的缩略及 flexi- 这一构词形式有关。它们最终都关联拉丁语 flectere（弯曲），由物理上的可弯曲发展出安排上的可调整。
etymology_story.en: The noun flexi is an informal shortening of flexitime, while the adjective is associated with shortened flexible and the combining form flexi-. These forms ultimately connect with Latin flectere, meaning to bend, extending physical bendability to adjustable arrangements.

morphology_enriched.zh: 名词：flexitime → flexi，属于截短构词；形容词：flexible → flexi，也体现截短。相关构词形式 flexi- 可与 time 组成 flexitime；相关词族包括 flex（弯曲）、flexible（灵活的）、flexibility（灵活性）、flexibly（灵活地）、inflexible（不灵活的）、inflexibility（僵化）和 inflexibly（不灵活地）。这些是相关词族成员，并非都由 flexi 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Noun: flexitime → flexi by clipping; adjective: flexible → flexi, also by shortening. The related combining form flexi- joins time in flexitime; the wider family includes flex, flexible, flexibility, flexibly, inflexible, inflexibility, and inflexibly. These are related family members rather than direct derivatives of flexi.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: 名词义：flexitime（弹性工作时间制）是较完整的名称；flexible working（灵活工作安排）范围更广，还可能涉及工作地点或工作量。形容词义：flexible（灵活的）适用范围最广；adjustable（可调节的）强调具体参数或设置能够调整。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: For the noun, flexitime is the fuller term, while flexible working is broader and may also concern location or workload. For the adjective, flexible has the widest application, whereas adjustable emphasizes changing particular settings or parameters.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 能“弯”的安排就是能调整的安排：flexi 表示时间或条件有弹性。
mnemonic_anchor.en: An arrangement that can 'bend' can adapt: flexi means flexibility in times or conditions.

etymology_story.zh: 来自古法语 parlement，原指谈话、讨论或议事集会，由 parler（说话）派生。它在法国逐渐成为特定高等法院的名称；英语在法国史语境中保留这一拼写，以区别于通常表示议会的 parliament。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from Old French parlement, originally a discussion or deliberative gathering, derived from parler, meaning to speak. In France it developed into the name of particular high courts; English retains this spelling in French historical contexts, distinguishing it from the usual legislative sense of parliament.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为完整的历史机构借词处理：parlement，复数 parlements。历史法语结构为 parl-（说话）+ -ement（名词后缀）；同源英语词有 parliament（议会），其派生词有 parliamentary（议会的）和 parliamentarian（议员、议会程序专家），但这些并非由现代英语 parlement 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats parlement as a complete borrowing naming a historical institution; its plural is parlements. Its historical French structure is parl- 'speak' + -ement, a noun suffix; the cognate parliament has derivatives such as parliamentary and parliamentarian, but these are not direct modern English derivatives of parlement.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: high court（高等法院）是较接近的通称；sovereign court（最高审级法院）强调它在旧制度司法体系中的地位；court of appeal（上诉法院）强调其审理上诉的职能。这些近义表达均不能完整体现 parlement 登记王室敕令等历史职能。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: High court is the closest general description; sovereign court emphasizes its standing in the ancien-régime judicial system; court of appeal highlights its appellate function. None fully captures its historical role in registering royal edicts.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: parl- 表示“说话、议事”：记住在法国史中，parlement 指法官议事断案的高等法院。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Parl- points to speaking and deliberation: in French history, picture judges deliberating in a high court.

etymology_story.zh: 由源自拉丁语、表示“跨越”的前缀 trans- 与英语 world 构成；world 源于古英语 weorold，其早期含义与“人的一生、人的时代”有关。在模态哲学中，“跨越世界”进一步指涉及不同的可能世界。
etymology_story.en: The word combines trans-, a prefix of Latin origin meaning “across,” with world, from Old English weorold, whose early meaning concerned human life or the human age. In modal philosophy, the idea of crossing worlds came to concern different possible worlds.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代结构：trans-（跨越）+ world（世界）→ transworld。该形容词没有常用的直接派生词；transworld identity 是术语短语。基础词 world 的相关词族包括 worldly（世俗的）、worldliness（世俗性）、unworldly（不谙世故的）和 worldwide（遍及全球的）。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: trans- (“across”) + world → transworld. The adjective has no established common direct derivatives; transworld identity is a technical phrase. The family of its base world includes worldly, worldliness, unworldly, and worldwide.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: worldwide（全球的）和 global（全球性的）可替换其一般地域义；cross-world（跨世界的）更接近哲学义。前两者通常涉及现实地球，后者可涉及不同可能世界。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Worldwide and global overlap with the geographical sense; cross-world is closer to the philosophical sense. The first two normally concern the actual Earth, while cross-world can concern different possible worlds.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: trans- 是“跨越”：跨地球各地，或跨不同可能世界。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Trans- means “across”: across the globe, or across possible worlds.

forms: 可数名词；复数tubifexes；水族饵料语境也可用集合式表达。

etymology.text: 英语借用新拉丁语动物属名Tubifex，名称由拉丁语tubus（管）和-fex（制造者）组成。可联想它在水底泥中形成的细管。

etymology_story.zh: 英语普通名词来自新拉丁语动物属名 Tubifex，由拉丁语 tubus（管）和 -fex（制造者，与 facere“制作”有关）构成。“造管者”这一名称指向这种蠕虫在底泥中形成或栖居的细管。
etymology_story.en: The English common noun comes from the New Latin genus name Tubifex, formed from Latin tubus (“tube”) and -fex (“maker,” related to facere, “make”). The name “tube maker” refers to the fine tubes these worms form or inhabit in sediment.

morphology_enriched.zh: 历史构词：tubi-（管）+ -fex（制造者）；现代英语通常将 tubifex 作为完整借词使用。可数复数为 tubifexes；属名写作 Tubifex。相关分类词 tubificid 指颤蚓类动物，范围较广，并非 tubifex 的普通英语直接派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: Historical formation: tubi- (“tube”) + -fex (“maker”); modern English generally treats tubifex as a complete borrowed word. Its count plural is tubifexes; the genus name is capitalized Tubifex. The related taxonomic term tubificid has a broader reference and is not an ordinary direct English derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sludge worm（污泥蠕虫）和 sewage worm（污水蠕虫）是相关俗称，强调栖息环境，所指未必严格限于颤蚓属；bloodworm（红虫）在水族语境中可能指外形相似的红色幼虫，不能视为严格同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sludge worm and sewage worm are overlapping common names that emphasize habitat and may extend beyond the genus Tubifex. Bloodworm can refer to superficially similar red larvae in aquarium contexts and is not an exact synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: tubi- 联想 tube：底泥里住细管的小蠕虫。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect tubi- with tube: a little worm living in a tube in the mud.

senses.collocation_zh: 一位法国子爵；子爵头衔

senses.sentence_zh: 这封信是写给一位法国子爵的。

etymology_story.zh: 英语借自法语 vicomte，可追溯至中古拉丁语 vicecomes，原指伯爵的副手，后来成为贵族爵位。英语 viscount 与它同源，但采用了不同的借入形式。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed vicomte from French; it ultimately derives from Medieval Latin vicecomes, originally a count’s deputy and later a noble title. English viscount shares this origin but entered English in a different form.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语将 vicomte 视为完整的法语借词，不宜把 vi- 当作能自由使用的英语前缀；历史结构对应 vice-（副）+ comes／comte（伯爵）。复数为 vicomtes；对应女性称谓为 vicomtesse（法国女监爵或子爵夫人），同源英语词为 viscount、viscountess 和 viscounty。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats vicomte as a complete French borrowing; vi- is not a productive English prefix here. Historically, it corresponds to vice- (“deputy”) + comes/comte (“count”). The plural is vicomtes; the corresponding feminine title is vicomtesse, meaning a French viscountess. English cognates include viscount, viscountess, and viscounty.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: viscount（子爵）是最接近的英语对应词；nobleman（贵族男子）是更宽泛的上位词；comte（法国伯爵）爵位更高，并非同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Viscount is the closest English equivalent; nobleman is a broader term. Comte means a French count, a higher rank, and is not a synonym.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 历史上的“副伯爵”发展为“子爵”：vicomte 对应 viscount。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A historical “deputy count” became a viscount: vicomte is the French title.

etymology.text: 来自拉丁语cento（拼接的衣服、补丁布），后来用于指把其他作品中的句子拼接起来的新作品。可把引文想成一块块布。

senses.meaning_zh: 集句诗；由其他作品的引文或片段拼成的作品
senses.meaning_en: a work, especially a poem, assembled from passages taken from other works
senses.english_definition: A cento is a poem or other work made by arranging lines or passages taken from existing works.
senses.collocation_en: compose a cento; a cento of quotations
senses.collocation_zh: 创作一首集句诗；由引文拼成的作品
senses.sentence_en: She composed a cento using lines from several nineteenth-century poets.
senses.sentence_zh: 她选用几位十九世纪诗人的诗句，创作了一首集句诗。

etymology_story.zh: 来自拉丁语 cento，原指用碎布拼成的衣物或覆盖物，后来用于指拼接其他作品片段而成的新作。其语义从“拼布”转向“拼接文字”。
etymology_story.en: Cento comes from Latin cento, a garment or covering made from pieces of cloth, later applied to a work assembled from passages of other works. Its meaning moved from patching fabric to patching together text.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中 cento 是不可再作常规拆分的借词；复数为 centos，也可用拉丁式 centones。历史词干 centon- 用于较少见的派生词 centonist（集句诗作者）、centonism（集句创作法）和 centonic（集句式的）；它与表示“一百”的 cent- 没有构词关系。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, cento is a borrowed base without a regular internal English breakdown; its plurals are centos and the Latin form centones. The historical stem centon- occurs in the uncommon derivatives centonist, centonism, and centonic. It is unrelated in formation to cent- meaning “hundred.”

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: collage（拼贴作品）是范围更广的对应词；compilation（汇编）强调汇集材料；pastiche（仿作或拼合之作）可以模仿风格而不直接引用。cento 的关键是用已有文本片段组成新作。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Collage is a broader parallel; compilation emphasizes collecting material; pastiche may imitate a style without directly quoting it. A cento specifically constructs a new work from pieces of existing texts.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把引文当碎布，拼成一首新诗。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Treat quotations as fabric patches and stitch them into a new poem.

etymology.text: 现代英语由mail与shot组合而成，借“一次投放”的shot来描绘同时向一批收件人寄出广告。

senses.meaning_zh: 广告邮件群发；批量寄发的广告材料，主要用于英国英语
senses.meaning_en: a mass mailing of advertising material, chiefly in British English
senses.english_definition: A mailshot is advertising material sent to many people at the same time, or the act of sending it.
senses.collocation_en: send out a mailshot; a direct mailshot
senses.collocation_zh: 群发广告邮件；一次直接邮寄广告
senses.sentence_en: The company sent out a mailshot advertising its new service.
senses.sentence_zh: 这家公司群发了广告邮件，推广其新服务。

senses.meaning_zh: 向一批收件人群发广告材料，主要用于英国英语
senses.meaning_en: to send advertising material to many recipients, chiefly in British English
senses.english_definition: If a company mailshots people, it sends advertising material to them as part of a mass mailing.
senses.collocation_en: mailshot potential customers; mailshot local businesses
senses.collocation_zh: 向潜在客户群发广告材料；向当地企业群发广告材料
senses.sentence_en: We mailshotted local businesses to promote the exhibition.
senses.sentence_zh: 我们向当地企业群发了广告材料，以宣传这次展览。

etymology_story.zh: 这是现代英语由 mail（邮件）和 shot（一次行动或投放）组成的复合词，用来指一次面向许多收件人的广告邮寄。名词后来也通过词类转换用作动词。
etymology_story.en: This modern English compound combines mail with shot in the sense of a single action or dispatch, describing an advertising mailing to many recipients. The noun also became a verb through conversion.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代结构：mail（邮件）+ shot（一次投放）→ mailshot；名词转用为动词，无须添加词缀。词形包括 mailshots（名词复数或动词第三人称单数）、mailshotted（过去式及过去分词）、mailshotting（现在分词）；基础词 mail 的相关词包括 mailing（邮寄；邮件材料）和 mailer（邮寄者；邮寄广告材料）。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: mail + shot (“a single dispatch”) → mailshot; conversion produces the verb without an added affix. Forms include mailshots, mailshotted, and mailshotting. Related words from the base mail include mailing and mailer.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: direct mail（直邮广告）通常指营销渠道或广告材料；mass mailing（大批量邮寄）强调数量，内容未必是广告；email blast（群发电子邮件）明确限于电子邮件。mailshot 通常指一次广告群发或其中的材料，传统上尤其指邮寄广告。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Direct mail usually names the marketing channel or its material; mass mailing emphasizes scale and need not involve advertising; email blast specifically concerns email. Mailshot usually identifies an individual advertising dispatch or its contents, traditionally especially postal advertising.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: mail + 一次 shot：一轮把广告寄给许多人。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Mail + one shot: send an advertisement to many people in one round.

senses.english_definition: A galleria is a covered passage or large enclosed space with shops opening onto it.

etymology_story.zh: 英语从意大利语 galleria 借入此词；它与 gallery 同源，可追溯至中古拉丁语 galeria，但更早的来源尚不确定。意大利语中表示长廊、画廊等空间的词，在英语中主要用于有顶购物长廊或购物中心的公共空间。
etymology_story.en: English borrowed galleria from Italian; it shares its ancestry with gallery and goes back to Medieval Latin galeria, whose earlier origin is uncertain. Whereas the Italian word can describe galleries and passages more generally, English mainly uses it for covered shopping passages and public spaces within shopping centers.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中，galleria 是整体借入的单纯词，不宜拆成英语词根和后缀；复数为 gallerias。相关同源词包括 gallery、galleries、galleried（有长廊的）和 gallerist（画廊经营者）；这些并不是由英语 galleria 直接派生的词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, galleria is a borrowed simplex rather than an English root-plus-suffix formation; its regular plural is gallerias. Related words include gallery, galleries, galleried, and gallerist, but these are not direct English derivatives of galleria.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: arcade 强调两侧设有商店的有顶通道；shopping mall 指整个购物中心，范围通常更大；atrium 强调建筑内部的高大中庭，不一定有商店。galleria 可兼具购物通道与宽敞公共空间的特点。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: An arcade emphasizes a covered passage lined with shops; a shopping mall is the shopping complex as a whole; an atrium is a tall central interior space that need not contain shops. A galleria can combine the features of a shopping passage and a spacious public court.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把同源词 gallery 的长廊画面换成两旁都是商店：galleria 就是购物长廊。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture the long space suggested by its relative gallery, then line it with shops: a galleria.

pronunciation.note: 英语读作 MAR-kay，重音在首音节，ch 发 /k/，末音节与 day 押韵。

morphology.text: Marche整词作为地名记忆；同源英语词march（边境地区） + -er → marcher（边境居民）。这个派生词帮助联想地名的边境含义。

etymology.text: 英语借自意大利语Marche，意大利语名称来自marche（边境地区，复数）。它保留了历史上边境辖区的地理含义。

senses.phonetic: English 英语 /ˈmɑːrkeɪ/; Italian 意大利语 /ˈmarke/
senses.meaning_zh: 马尔凯，意大利中部濒临亚得里亚海的大区
senses.meaning_en: a region of central Italy on the Adriatic coast
senses.english_definition: Marche is a region in central Italy that extends from the Apennine Mountains to the Adriatic Sea.
senses.collocation_en: the Marche region; the coast of Marche
senses.collocation_zh: 马尔凯大区；马尔凯海岸
senses.sentence_en: They spent a week exploring the hill towns of Marche.
senses.sentence_zh: 他们花了一周时间游览马尔凯的山城。

etymology_story.zh: Marche 来自意大利语 marca（边境地区、边区）的复数 marche，名称保留了当地历史上多个边境辖区的记忆。这个表示边区的词具有日耳曼语来源，与英语 march 的“边境地区”义同源。
etymology_story.en: Marche comes from marche, the plural of Italian marca, meaning a frontier territory, and recalls the area's historical division into several marches. This territorial term has Germanic origins and is related to English march in its sense of a border district.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中，Marche 是整体借入的专有地名，没有可自由组合的英语词根或后缀；词尾 -e 是意大利语历史复数形式的一部分，并非英语后缀。意大利语相关居民称谓包括 marchigiano（男性）和 marchigiana（女性）；英语 march、marcher 属于历史相关词，不是 Marche 的直接派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, Marche is a borrowed proper name with no productive English root-and-affix structure; its final -e belongs to the Italian plural form rather than an English suffix. Related Italian inhabitant terms include marchigiano for a man and marchigiana for a woman; English march and marcher are historical relatives, not direct derivatives of Marche.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Le Marche 是带意大利语定冠词的名称形式；the Marches 是传统英语名称；the Italian Marches 是更明确的英语称呼，可避免与其他边区混淆。它们是同一地区的名称变体，不是普通词汇意义上的近义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Le Marche is the name with the Italian definite article; the Marches is a traditional English name; the Italian Marches makes the reference explicit and avoids confusion with other frontier districts. These are alternative names for the same region rather than ordinary lexical synonyms.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 march 的“边区”义想成复数：历史上的多个边区，留下了 Marche 这个地名。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Think of several marches, or frontier districts: their historical grouping survives in the name Marche.

etymology.text: 经奥斯曼土耳其语peri来自波斯语pari，英语借来指波斯传说中的美丽仙灵。可以联想会飞的仙灵形象。

senses.phonetic: British English 英式英语 /ˈpɪəri/; American English 美式英语 /ˈpɪri/
senses.meaning_zh: 佩里仙灵，波斯传说中美丽的精灵，常被描绘为有翼形象
senses.meaning_en: a beautiful supernatural being in Persian folklore, often represented with wings
senses.english_definition: A peri is a beautiful spirit in Persian stories, often described as having wings.
senses.collocation_en: a beautiful peri; a winged peri
senses.collocation_zh: 美丽的佩里仙灵；有翼的佩里仙灵
senses.sentence_en: In the tale, a peri appears beside the fountain at dawn.
senses.sentence_zh: 故事中，一位佩里仙灵在黎明时出现在喷泉旁。

etymology_story.zh: peri 最终源于波斯语 parī，土耳其语 peri 是这一名称传播过程中的中介形式之一。它的古代伊朗语前身指带有邪恶色彩的超自然存在，后来在波斯故事中逐渐转为美丽、往往较友善的仙灵形象。
etymology_story.en: Peri ultimately comes from Persian parī, with Turkish peri among the forms through which the name spread. Its ancient Iranian predecessor referred to a sinister supernatural being, but later Persian storytelling developed the image of a beautiful and often more benevolent spirit.

morphology_enriched.zh: peri 是整体借入的单纯词，复数为 peris，没有常用的英语派生词族。perilike 可作为临时构造的“像佩里仙灵的”形容词理解，但不宜当作常用派生词；此名词与表示“周围”的希腊语来源前缀 peri- 无关。
morphology_enriched.en: Peri is a borrowed simplex, with the plural peris and no commonly used English derivative family. Perilike is understandable as an occasional formation meaning 'resembling a peri,' but should not be presented as a common derivative; the noun is unrelated to the Greek-derived prefix peri-, meaning 'around.'

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: fairy 是英语中较宽泛的仙灵称呼；sprite 常指轻盈小巧的精灵；angel 属于宗教中的天使概念。peri 特指波斯传统中的仙灵，不能与这些词完全互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Fairy is a broader English term for a magical being; sprite often suggests a small, delicate spirit; angel belongs to religious traditions. Peri specifically identifies a being from Persian folklore, so none of these terms is fully interchangeable with it.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把 peri 与 Persian“波斯的”连成画面：波斯故事里的美丽有翼仙灵；这是联想，不是词源拆分。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Link peri with Persian in a mental picture: a beautiful winged spirit from a Persian tale. This is a memory association, not an etymological breakdown.

etymology.text: 英语用 under- 与 lease 组合而成；把原租约想成上层，下层另订的租约就是转租租约。

senses.meaning_zh: 转租租约；由承租人向次承租人授予的下一级租约
senses.meaning_en: a lease granted by a tenant to a subtenant
senses.english_definition: An underlease is a lease that a tenant grants to another person for all or part of the property they rent.
senses.collocation_en: grant an underlease; the terms of an underlease
senses.collocation_zh: 授予转租租约；转租租约的条款
senses.sentence_en: The underlease covers two rooms on the first floor.
senses.sentence_zh: 这份转租租约涵盖一楼的两个房间。

senses.meaning_zh: 转租；将自己承租的房产全部或部分再出租
senses.meaning_en: to grant another person a lease of property that one holds as a tenant
senses.english_definition: If you underlease a property, you rent all or part of it to another person while remaining a tenant under your own lease.
senses.collocation_en: underlease the premises; underlease part of a property
senses.collocation_zh: 转租该处房产；转租房产的一部分
senses.sentence_en: The company plans to underlease part of its office space.
senses.sentence_zh: 这家公司计划转租部分办公空间。

etymology_story.zh: underlease 由 under- 与 lease 在英语内部组合而成，under- 表示租赁关系中的下一级。由原承租人授予的新租约从属于上一级租约，因此这个词既可指该租约，也可指订立这种转租关系的行为。
etymology_story.en: Underlease was formed in English from under- and lease, with under- marking a subordinate level in a leasing relationship. Because the tenant's new lease sits beneath an existing lease, the word can name either that subordinate lease or the act of granting it.

morphology_enriched.zh: under-（下一级、从属）+ lease（租约；出租）→ underlease；同形兼作名词和动词。常用屈折形式为 underleases、underleased、underleasing；相关角色名词为 underlessee（次承租人）和 underlessor（转租出租人，即上一级租约中的承租人）。
morphology_enriched.en: Under- ('subordinate') + lease ('a lease; to let') forms underlease, used as both noun and verb. Its regular inflected forms are underleases, underleased, and underleasing; related participant nouns are underlessee, the subtenant, and underlessor, the tenant who grants the subordinate lease.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sublease 与 underlease 最接近，均可指转租租约或转租行为；sublet 常用作动词，强调把承租的房产再租给别人；tenancy 泛指租赁占有关系，不一定涉及转租。underlease 尤见于英国正式房地产用语。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sublease is the closest equivalent and can name both the agreement and the action; sublet is commonly a verb emphasizing renting leased property to someone else; tenancy refers more broadly to occupation under a rental arrangement. Underlease occurs especially in formal British property usage.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 上面已有一份 lease，下面再接一份 lease：underlease 就是下一级转租。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture one lease underneath another: the lower lease is an underlease.

senses.meaning_zh: 塞恩；盎格鲁－撒克逊英格兰或中世纪苏格兰的贵族、领主
senses.meaning_en: a nobleman or lord in Anglo-Saxon England or medieval Scotland
senses.english_definition: A thane was a man of noble rank in Anglo-Saxon England or medieval Scotland, often holding land and serving a king or a more powerful lord.
senses.collocation_en: a Scottish thane; the Thane of Cawdor
senses.collocation_zh: 苏格兰领主；考德爵士
senses.sentence_en: In Shakespeare's play, Macbeth becomes the Thane of Cawdor.
senses.sentence_zh: 在莎士比亚的剧中，麦克白成为考德爵士。

etymology_story.zh: thane 由古英语 þegn 经中古英语的相关形式演变而来，早期含有仆从、侍从或追随者之意。随着为君主或大领主效力的人获得土地和地位，这个词逐渐成为贵族身份的称谓；其在英格兰和苏格兰的具体制度含义有所不同。
etymology_story.en: Thane developed from Old English þegn through related Middle English forms, originally referring to a servant, attendant, or retainer. As service to a king or powerful lord became associated with landholding and status, the word developed into a title of rank, with different institutional meanings in England and Scotland.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中，thane 是不可进一步作常规词缀拆分的词干，复数为 thanes。历史性派生词包括 thane + -dom → thanedom（领主身份或领地）、thane + -ship → thaneship（领主身份），以及 thanage（领主身份、职权或领地）；thegn 是历史研究中常见的对应拼写，并非派生词。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, thane is an underived stem, with the plural thanes. Historical derivatives include thane + -dom → thanedom, denoting rank or territory; thane + -ship → thaneship, denoting status; and thanage, denoting rank, authority, or territory. Thegn is a corresponding spelling common in historical scholarship, not a derivative.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: lord 是范围更广的领主或贵族称谓；nobleman 泛指贵族男子；retainer 强调为权贵服务的侍从身份，本身不表示贵族等级。thane 则具有特定的英格兰或苏格兰历史制度背景。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Lord is a broader title or description of a person with noble authority; nobleman means any man of noble rank; retainer emphasizes service to a powerful person without necessarily implying nobility. Thane carries a specific English or Scottish historical setting.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 抓住“为王效力的人获得土地与身份”：从侍从到领主，就是 thane 的意义发展。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Remember a royal retainer gaining land and rank: service developing into lordship captures the history of thane.

senses.meaning_zh: 叶腋；叶或枝与其所着生的茎之间的上侧夹角处
senses.meaning_en: the upper angle between a leaf or branch and the stem from which it grows
senses.english_definition: An axil is the upper angle where a leaf or branch joins the stem of a plant.
senses.collocation_en: leaf axil; a bud in the axil
senses.collocation_zh: 叶腋；叶腋中的芽
senses.sentence_en: A small bud developed in the axil of each leaf.
senses.sentence_zh: 每片叶的叶腋处都长出了一个小芽。

etymology_story.zh: 来自拉丁语 axilla，原义为“腋窝”。植物学借用这一人体部位的形象，指叶或枝与茎之间类似腋窝的夹角处。
etymology_story.en: Axil comes from Latin axilla, meaning “armpit.” Botanical usage transferred this bodily image to the armpit-like angle between a leaf or branch and its stem.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中将 axil 作为完整词基，不作有实际意义的进一步拆分；复数为 axils。相关形容词有 axillary（腋部的；腋生的）、axillar（腋部的；腋生的）和 axillate（具叶腋的）；这些词体现拉丁语词干 axill-，不能把 axillary 简单拼成 axil + -ary。相关拉丁语借词 axilla 指“腋窝”，复数为 axillae。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, axil is best treated as a whole base; its plural is axils. Related adjectives include axillary (“of an armpit; growing in an axil”), axillar (“axillary”), and axillate (“having axils”); these reflect the Latin stem axill-, so axillary is not simply spelled axil + -ary. The related Latin loan axilla means “armpit,” with the plural axillae.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: axilla：植物学中可作 axil 的术语性同义词，但在解剖学中通常指腋窝；leaf axil：明确限定为叶与茎之间的叶腋；node：指茎上着生叶或枝的节，与叶腋位置相关，但并非同义词。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Axilla can be a technical botanical synonym, although it usually means an armpit in anatomy; leaf axil specifically identifies the angle between a leaf and its stem; node means the attachment region on a stem and is related in location but is not synonymous.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把叶片想成伸出的手臂：叶与茎之间的“腋窝”就是 axil。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a leaf as an outstretched arm: its “armpit” against the stem is the axil.

senses.meaning_zh: 大斋期的；四旬期的；与该时期的斋戒或宗教活动有关的
senses.meaning_en: relating to Lent or its fasting and religious observances
senses.english_definition: Lenten activities and practices are connected with Lent, the Christian period of preparation before Easter.

etymology_story.zh: Lenten 与 Lent 同源，后者源自古英语 lencten，最初意为“春季”。这个季节名称后来专指复活节前的斋戒时期，Lenten 则表示与这一时期有关。
etymology_story.en: Lenten belongs to the same historical family as Lent, which comes from Old English lencten, originally meaning “spring.” The seasonal name came to designate the fasting period before Easter, and Lenten describes things associated with that period.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词可分析为 Lent（大斋期）+ -en（构成形容词的后缀）→ Lenten。核心词族为 Lent 和 Lenten；两者通常首字母大写。Lenten 不与 lend 的过去式 lent 构成同一词族。
morphology_enriched.en: The modern formation can be analyzed as Lent + the adjective-forming suffix -en → Lenten. The core word family consists of Lent and Lenten, both normally capitalized. Lenten is unrelated to lent, the past tense of lend.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: of Lent：与核心义最接近的释义短语；penitential：强调忏悔和补赎，不限于四旬期；fasting：强调禁食或节制饮食，也可用于非宗教语境。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Of Lent is the closest explanatory equivalent; penitential emphasizes repentance and penance without being limited to Lent; fasting emphasizes abstaining from food and can also describe nonreligious practices.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: Lent 是四旬期，Lenten 就是“四旬期的”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Lent names the season; Lenten means “belonging to Lent.”

senses.meaning_zh: （尤指英国大学教席或教授职位）由君主创设或以王室名义设立的
senses.meaning_en: established by a monarch, especially of a university professorship
senses.english_definition: A regius professorship is a university position established by a king or queen.
senses.collocation_en: Regius Professor; a regius professorship
senses.collocation_zh: 王室钦定教授；王室设立的教授职位
senses.sentence_en: She was appointed Regius Professor of History.
senses.sentence_zh: 她获任王室钦定历史学教授。

etymology_story.zh: 直接借自拉丁语 rēgius，意为“国王的；王室的”，来自 rēx“国王”，其词干为 rēg-。英语主要在由君主创设的大学教席及其教授头衔中保留这个词。
etymology_story.en: Regius was borrowed directly from Latin rēgius, meaning “royal,” from rēx, “king,” whose stem is rēg-. English preserves the word chiefly in the names of university chairs established by monarchs and the titles of their holders.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中将 regius 作为整体借词记忆；历史结构为拉丁语 rēg-（国王）+ -ius（形容词词尾）。常用结构为 Regius Professor 和 regius professorship，其中 professorship 由 professor + -ship 构成。英语中 regius 没有常用的直接派生词；regal（帝王般的）、regally（有帝王气派地）、regalia（王室礼服及标志物）属于历史相关词，而非由 regius 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, regius is treated as a whole loanword; its historical structure is Latin rēg- (“king”) + the adjectival ending -ius. Common constructions include Regius Professor and regius professorship, with professorship formed from professor + -ship. Regius has no common direct English derivatives; regal, regally, and regalia are historically related words, not derivatives of regius.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: royal：泛指王室的或与君主有关的，适用范围最广；royally founded：明确表示由君主创设，与 regius 的教席用法接近；endowed：强调获得捐资或基金支持，但不说明资助者是否为王室。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Royal broadly means connected with a monarch or royal family; royally founded closely matches the institutional sense of regius; endowed emphasizes financial support without identifying the donor as royal.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: reg- 关联“国王”：regius chair 就是由君主创设的教席。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect reg- with “king”: a regius chair is a university chair founded by a monarch.

senses.meaning_zh: 滴酒不沾的人；完全戒酒者
senses.meaning_en: a person who abstains completely from alcoholic drinks
senses.english_definition: A teetotaller is someone who does not drink alcohol.
senses.collocation_en: a strict teetotaller; a lifelong teetotaller
senses.collocation_zh: 严格滴酒不沾的人；终身不饮酒的人
senses.sentence_en: As a lifelong teetotaller, he always chooses an alcohol-free drink.
senses.sentence_zh: 他一生滴酒不沾，总是选择不含酒精的饮料。

etymology_story.zh: 这个词来自 teetotal，其 tee- 是对 total 首音的强调性重复；这种说法在19世纪30年代英国的戒酒运动中流行起来。加上表示人的 -er 后，指完全不饮酒的人，与 tea“茶”无关。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from teetotal, in which tee- emphatically repeats the opening sound of total; the expression became popular in the British temperance movement of the 1830s. Adding the person-forming suffix -er produced a word for someone who abstains completely from alcohol; it is unrelated to tea.

morphology_enriched.zh: teetotal（滴酒不沾的）+ -er（人）→ teetotaller，英式拼写在加后缀时双写 l；美式通常写作 teetotaler。词族包括 teetotal、teetotaller／teetotaler、teetotalism（完全禁酒；完全戒酒的主张或实践）以及 teetotally（完全地，非正式用法）。
morphology_enriched.en: Teetotal (“abstaining completely from alcohol”) + the person-forming suffix -er → teetotaller, with doubled l in British spelling; American English usually has teetotaler. The family includes teetotal, teetotaller/teetotaler, teetotalism (“the practice or advocacy of complete abstinence from alcohol”), and informal teetotally (“completely”).

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: abstainer：指主动不参与某种活动的人，具体是否戒酒取决于语境；non-drinker：中性地说明不饮酒，通常不强调理念；abstinent person：强调自我节制，但可涉及酒以外的事物。teetotaller 明确指完全不喝酒的人，但不必然主张他人禁酒。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Abstainer describes someone who deliberately refrains from something, with context determining whether alcohol is meant; non-drinker neutrally describes someone who does not drink alcohol; abstinent person emphasizes restraint but may concern things other than alcohol. Teetotaller specifically means complete abstinence from alcohol without necessarily implying advocacy.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: tee- 把 total“完全”再强调一次：对酒精是“完全不碰”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Tee- reinforces total: a teetotaller is totally alcohol-free.

senses.meaning_zh: 获专业团体授予执业资格或资格证书的人
senses.meaning_en: a person awarded a professional qualification or authorization by a qualifying body
senses.english_definition: A licentiate is someone who has received a qualification from a professional organization, sometimes allowing them to practise a profession.
senses.collocation_en: a licentiate of a professional body; a licentiate diploma
senses.collocation_zh: 获专业团体授予资格的人；专业资格文凭

senses.meaning_zh: 某些国家或大学授予的学位；该学位的获得者
senses.meaning_en: an academic degree awarded in certain educational systems, or a person holding it
senses.english_definition: A licentiate is a degree awarded by some universities, or someone who holds that degree; its level depends on the educational system.
senses.collocation_en: a licentiate in theology; a licentiate degree
senses.collocation_zh: 神学特许学位或其获得者；特许学位
senses.sentence_en: He earned a licentiate in theology before beginning his doctoral research.
senses.sentence_zh: 他在开始博士研究之前取得了神学特许学位。

etymology_story.zh: 源自中世纪拉丁语 licentiātus，意为“获得许可的人”，与 licentiāre“准许”和 licentia“许可”有关。在大学传统中，它与获得授课许可相联系，后来也用于某些学位及专业资格的获得者。
etymology_story.en: Licentiate derives from Medieval Latin licentiātus, “one who has been licensed,” related to licentiāre, “to authorize,” and licentia, “permission.” In university traditions it was associated with permission to teach, and it later also designated certain academic qualifications and holders of professional credentials.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中宜将 licentiate 作为整体借词，不把结尾 -ate 理解为这里具有独立造词作用的动词后缀；复数为 licentiates。直接派生词为 licentiate + -ship → licentiateship（特许资格；相应身份或学位）。历史相关词族包括 licence／license（许可；执照）、licensed（获许可的）、licensing（许可授予）、licensee（获许可者）、licensor（许可授予者）和 licensable（可获许可的），它们并非由 licentiate 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, licentiate is best treated as a whole loanword, rather than interpreting its ending as a productive verbal suffix -ate; its plural is licentiates. A direct derivative is licentiate + -ship → licentiateship (“the qualification, status, or degree of a licentiate”). Historically related words include licence/license, licensed, licensing, licensee, licensor, and licensable; these are not direct derivatives of licentiate.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: licensee：强调获得法律或合同许可的人，也可指企业，不必持有学术或专业资格；certificate holder：泛指证书持有人，证书未必赋予执业权；graduate：强调完成某项课程或取得学位，不说明是否拥有特许资格。licentiate 通常是特定制度中的正式资格或学位称号。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Licensee emphasizes possession of legal or contractual permission and can also refer to a company; certificate holder broadly describes someone with a certificate, which may confer no right to practise; graduate emphasizes completion of a course or degree without identifying a licentiate qualification. Licentiate is usually a formal title within a particular professional or academic system.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 与 licence“许可”联系：licentiate 的核心是“取得正式许可或相应资格的人”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Connect it with licence: a licentiate has received formal authorization or a corresponding qualification.

senses.meaning_zh: 电传打字机；通过电信线路收发并打印文字的设备
senses.meaning_en: A machine that sends and receives typed messages over a telecommunications connection and prints them.
senses.english_definition: A teleprinter is a machine that sends typed messages to another machine and prints the messages it receives.
senses.collocation_en: teleprinter network; teleprinter message
senses.collocation_zh: 电传打字通信网；电传消息

etymology_story.zh: teleprinter 由 tele-“远距离”和 printer“打印设备”组合而成，其中 tele- 源自希腊语 tēle“远”。这个名称指能通过电信线路传送文字，并在接收端打印出来的设备。
etymology_story.en: Teleprinter combines tele-, meaning 'at a distance' and ultimately from Greek tēle, with printer. The name describes a machine that transmits text over telecommunications lines and prints it at the receiving end.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：tele-（远距离）+ print（打印）+ -er（执行者或设备），也可直接分析为 tele- + printer。相关词形与词族：teleprinters（复数）、teleprinting（电传打字；电传打印过程）；基础词族包括 print、printer、printing、printout、reprint、printable。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: tele- ('at a distance') + print + -er ('an agent or device'), or more directly tele- + printer. Related forms include teleprinters and teleprinting; the underlying print family includes print, printer, printing, printout, reprint, and printable.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: teletype（电传打字机）与 teleprinter 基本同义，尤见于美式英语，源于商标名称；telex（用户电报）主要指利用此类设备提供的通信系统或服务，也可指设备或消息；printer（打印机）只强调打印功能，不必具备远程收发功能。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Teletype is a near-equivalent, especially in American English, and originated as a trademark. Telex primarily names a communication system or service using such machines, though it can also name a machine or message. Printer describes the printing function without necessarily implying remote message transmission.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: tele-＝远，printer＝打印机：把远方传来的文字打印出来。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Tele- means 'far': a teleprinter prints words sent from far away.

senses.meaning_zh: 笨拙的人；懒汉，尤指身材粗壮而行动迟钝者，现多用于旧式或航海语境
senses.meaning_en: A clumsy or lazy person, especially a large, awkward one; now chiefly old-fashioned or nautical.
senses.english_definition: If someone calls a person a lubber, they mean that the person is awkward, clumsy, or lazy.
senses.collocation_en: a lazy lubber; a clumsy lubber
senses.collocation_zh: 一个懒汉；一个笨手笨脚的人
senses.sentence_en: In the old sea story, the captain calls the idle sailor a lazy lubber.
senses.sentence_zh: 在那个古老的航海故事里，船长把那名无所事事的水手叫作懒汉。

etymology_story.zh: lubber 可追溯至中古英语，当时用于指笨拙、迟钝或懒散的人，其更早来源不确定。它后来也用于航海语境，并保留在 landlubber“缺乏航海经验的人”中。
etymology_story.en: Lubber goes back to Middle English, where it referred to an awkward, sluggish, or idle person; its earlier origin is uncertain. It also developed nautical associations and survives in landlubber, meaning someone inexperienced at sea.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中将 lubber 作为整体词干，不宜拆成 lub + -er。相关词形与词族：lubbers（复数）、lubberly（形容词：笨拙的；副词：笨拙地）、lubberliness（笨拙）；复合词 landlubber（不熟悉航海的人）及其形容词 landlubberly。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, lubber is an unanalyzed stem, not a transparent combination of lub and -er. Related forms include lubbers, lubberly (adjective and adverb), and lubberliness, together with the compound landlubber and its adjective landlubberly.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: oaf（笨汉）侧重粗笨、欠缺教养；lout（粗野的人）侧重举止粗鲁；idler（游手好闲的人）只强调不做事。lubber 可兼有笨拙与懒散两层意思，并带有旧式用语色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Oaf emphasizes clumsiness and lack of refinement; lout emphasizes rough or rude behavior; idler emphasizes inactivity. Lubber can combine awkwardness with laziness and has an old-fashioned flavor.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 借 landlubber 联想：陆地上的人刚上船，笨手笨脚；这是联想，不是词源解释。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a landlubber stumbling on a ship: awkward movement anchors lubber. This is a memory association, not an etymology.

senses.pos: n. 名词（基督教称号，通常大写）
senses.meaning_zh: 保惠师；基督教中作为帮助者、代求者或安慰者的圣灵
senses.meaning_en: The Holy Spirit understood as a helper, advocate, or comforter in Christianity.
senses.english_definition: In Christianity, the Paraclete is the Holy Spirit, who helps, guides, and comforts believers.
senses.collocation_en: the promised Paraclete; the coming of the Paraclete
senses.collocation_zh: 所应许的保惠师；保惠师的降临
senses.sentence_en: The sermon described the Paraclete as the helper promised to the disciples.
senses.sentence_zh: 这篇讲道将保惠师描述为应许赐给门徒的帮助者。

etymology_story.zh: Paraclete 经教会拉丁语源自希腊语 paraklētos，本义为“被召到身边提供帮助的人”，可指帮助者或代言者。在基督教用语中，它成为圣灵的称号，传统上译作“保惠师”。
etymology_story.en: Paraclete comes through ecclesiastical Latin from Greek paraklētos, literally someone called to another person's side to help, hence a helper or advocate. In Christian usage it became a title of the Holy Spirit, traditionally rendered as 'Comforter' or 'Advocate.'

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中作为借入的完整词干使用，不宜视作能自由组合的英语前缀与词根。历史结构为希腊语 para-（在旁）+ klētos（被召来的，与 kalein“召唤”相关）；相关派生词 paracletic（保惠师的；具有安慰或代求作用的）较罕见。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English treats this as a borrowed whole stem rather than a freely productive English prefix–root combination. Historically it contains Greek para- ('beside') and klētos ('called,' related to kalein, 'to call'); the related adjective paracletic is rare.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: Advocate（代求者／辩护者）强调代表他人发言或代求；Comforter（安慰者）强调安慰与扶助；Helper（帮助者）含义较宽。三者在相关神学语境中突出 Paraclete 的不同侧面，并非在所有语境中都可互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Advocate emphasizes representation or intercession; Comforter emphasizes consolation and support; Helper is broader. In the relevant theological context, these highlight different aspects of Paraclete rather than functioning as interchangeable terms everywhere.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: “被召到身边帮助的人”→ 保惠师。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Someone 'called alongside to help' becomes the Paraclete.

etymology_story.zh: Portakabin 原为商业品牌名称，其拼写让人联想到 portable“可搬运的”和 cabin“小屋”，其中 kabin 是 cabin 的品牌化拼写。它有时被宽泛地用于指活动房，但严格用法仍指该品牌的建筑。
etymology_story.en: Portakabin originated as a commercial brand name whose spelling evokes portable and cabin, with kabin serving as a distinctive spelling of cabin. It is sometimes used loosely for portable buildings, but its precise reference remains buildings of that brand.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代结构：品牌造词，可理解为 porta-（使人联想到 portable“可搬运的”）+ kabin（cabin“小屋”的变体拼写）；这里的 porta- 不宜当作普通英语中可自由使用的前缀。词形包括 Portakabins（复数）；常作名词定语，如 Portakabin office；没有常用的普通派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: a coined brand name interpretable as porta- (evoking portable) + kabin (a respelling of cabin); porta- here should not be treated as a freely productive ordinary English prefix. Forms include the plural Portakabins and attributive uses such as Portakabin office; there is no common general-purpose derivational family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: portable building（活动建筑）是强调可搬迁性的通称；prefabricated building（预制建筑）强调构件或建筑在工厂预先制造，未必便于搬迁；modular building（模块化建筑）强调由预制模块组合。Portakabin 则特指品牌。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Portable building is a generic term emphasizing relocatability. Prefabricated building emphasizes manufacture in advance, usually in a factory, without necessarily implying easy relocation. Modular building emphasizes construction from prefabricated modules. Portakabin identifies a brand.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: portable + cabin 的拼写联想：可以搬走的小屋；记住它是品牌名。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Think 'portable cabin': a building that can move, with a distinctive brand spelling.

etymology_story.zh: adrenergic 是由 adrenaline“肾上腺素”的缩略词干与 -ergic 构成的科学术语，后者最终源自希腊语 ergon“工作、作用”。该词用于描述肾上腺素及去甲肾上腺素所参与的神经传递、受体和生理作用。
etymology_story.en: Adrenergic was formed as a scientific term from a shortened stem of adrenaline and -ergic, ultimately related to Greek ergon, 'work' or 'action.' It describes neurotransmission, receptors, and physiological effects involving adrenaline and noradrenaline.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代构词：adren-（此处指向 adrenaline“肾上腺素”）+ -ergic（涉及某种作用或活动的）。相关词形与词族：adrenergically（以肾上腺素能方式）、adrenergics（名词复数）、antiadrenergic（抗肾上腺素能的）、noradrenergic（去甲肾上腺素能的）；相关基础词包括 adrenaline／adrenalin（肾上腺素）和 noradrenaline（去甲肾上腺素）。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern structure: adren- (here referring to adrenaline) + -ergic ('involving a particular action or activity'). Related forms include adrenergically, the noun plural adrenergics, antiadrenergic, and noradrenergic; related base vocabulary includes adrenaline/adrenalin and noradrenaline.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sympathomimetic（拟交感神经的／拟交感神经药）强调模拟交感神经活动的效应，与药物意义的 adrenergic 大量重叠；noradrenergic（去甲肾上腺素能的）专指去甲肾上腺素相关作用；catecholaminergic（儿茶酚胺能的）范围更广，还包括多巴胺等儿茶酚胺相关作用。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sympathomimetic emphasizes effects that imitate sympathetic nervous activity and overlaps substantially with adrenergic in drug terminology. Noradrenergic specifically concerns noradrenaline. Catecholaminergic is broader, also covering other catecholamines such as dopamine.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: adren- 联想到肾上腺素，-ergic 联想到“起作用”：肾上腺素类信号在发挥作用。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Link adren- with adrenaline and -ergic with action: adrenaline-type signaling at work.

senses.sentence_zh: 照片中，一群度假者正乘坐敞篷游览客车出发。

etymology_story.zh: 借自法语 char à bancs，字面义为“装有长凳的车”，最初指设有多排座凳的马拉客车。后来，这个名称也用于供团体出游的早期机动客车。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from French char à bancs, literally “carriage with benches,” originally referring to a horse-drawn passenger vehicle with rows of seats. The name was later applied to early motor coaches used for group excursions.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中，charabanc 通常作为不可再作常规词缀拆分的借词处理；历史结构为法语 char（车）+ à（带有）+ bancs（长凳）。复数为 charabancs；罕见的历史用语 charabancing 指乘这种客车出游，现代常用派生词很少。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, charabanc is normally treated as an unanalyzed borrowing rather than a productive root-and-affix formation; its historical French structure is char “carriage” + à “with” + bancs “benches.” The plural is charabancs; the rare historical formation charabancing means taking excursions in such vehicles, and there are few common modern derivatives.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: coach（长途或旅游客车）是较宽泛的现代用词；tour bus（旅游巴士）强调观光用途；open-top bus（敞篷巴士）强调车顶结构。charabanc 则带有鲜明的旧时集体出游色彩，三者都不能在所有语境中与之完全互换。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Coach is a broader modern term for a passenger vehicle used on longer journeys; tour bus emphasizes sightseeing; open-top bus emphasizes the roof design. Charabanc specifically evokes historical group excursions, so none is interchangeable with it in every context.

etymology_story.zh: 铟于1863年通过光谱分析被发现，其名称取自 indigo（靛蓝），因为研究者观察到了具有辨识度的靛蓝色光谱线。名称中的 -ium 是金属元素名称中常见的词尾。
etymology_story.en: Indium was discovered through spectroscopic analysis in 1863 and named after indigo because of a distinctive indigo-blue spectral line. Its ending, -ium, is common in the names of metallic elements.

morphology_enriched.zh: 命名结构为 indi-（取自 indigo“靛蓝”的词干）+ -ium（元素名称词尾）。现代英语通常把 indium 作为完整元素名使用，没有常用的普通词汇派生系列；indium-based（铟基的）和 indium-containing（含铟的）是可按需构成的复合修饰语。
morphology_enriched.en: The naming structure is indi-, taken from indigo, + -ium, an element-name ending. Modern English normally treats indium as a complete element name, with no common general-vocabulary derivative series; indium-based and indium-containing are productive compound modifiers.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: indium 没有常用的严格词汇近义词：In 是同一元素的化学符号；metal（金属）和 chemical element（化学元素）都是范围更大的上位词，不能替代其精确名称。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Indium has no common strict lexical synonyms: In is the chemical symbol for the same element, while metal and chemical element are broader category terms that do not identify it precisely.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: indigo（靛蓝）→ 靛蓝色谱线 → indium（铟）。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Indigo light identifies indium: remember the element through its blue spectral line.

senses.collocation_zh: 腕中央骨；跗中央骨
senses.sentence_en: In this species, the centrale remains separate from the surrounding wrist bones.
senses.sentence_zh: 在这个物种中，中央骨保持独立，没有与周围的腕骨融合。

etymology_story.zh: 借自新拉丁语 centrale，是 centralis（中央的）的中性形式，作名词时意为“中央的部分”。比较解剖学用它命名某些动物腕部或跗部位于中央的小骨。
etymology_story.en: Centrale comes from New Latin centrale, the neuter form of centralis, meaning “central,” used substantivally for a central part. Comparative anatomy adopted it for a centrally situated bone in the wrist or ankle skeleton of certain animals.

morphology_enriched.zh: 历史结构为拉丁语 centr-（中心）+ -alis（……的）→ centralis，其中性形式 centrale 被借入英语作名词；这不是现代英语中的 centrale 加词缀构词。专业复数为 centralia；central（中央的）和 centrally（在中央）属于同源相关词，并非由 centrale 直接派生。
morphology_enriched.en: Historically, Latin centr- “center” + -alis “pertaining to” produced centralis, whose neuter form centrale was borrowed as an English noun; this is not a productive modern English affix pattern. Its technical plural is centralia; central and centrally are related formations from the same historical base, rather than direct derivatives of centrale.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: central bone（中央骨）是解释性表达，但单独使用时可能指其他位置的骨；central carpal bone（腕中央骨）限定腕部；central tarsal bone（跗中央骨）限定跗部。后两者是否与 centrale 对应，取决于所讨论物种及其解剖命名体系。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Central bone is an explanatory phrase but may refer to bones elsewhere without context; central carpal bone specifies the wrist, and central tarsal bone specifies the tarsus. Whether either more specific term corresponds to centrale depends on the species and anatomical naming system.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: centr- 表示“中心”：记住腕部或跗部中央的那块小骨。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Centr- points to the center: picture a small bone in the middle of a wrist or ankle.

etymology_story.zh: 来自拉丁语 comes、属格 comitis 的词干 comit-，加上表示“……的”的词尾。comes 原指“同伴、随从”，后来成为官职和贵族称号，其历史发展也产生了英语 count（伯爵）一词。
etymology_story.en: Comital is formed from comit-, the stem of Latin comes, genitive comitis, with an adjectival ending. Comes originally meant “companion” or “attendant” before developing into an official and noble title; the English title count ultimately comes from the same source.

morphology_enriched.zh: 可分析为 comit-（表示伯爵的拉丁语黏着词干）+ -al（……的）。常见相关词有 count（伯爵）、countess（女伯爵；伯爵夫人）和 county（郡；历史上与伯爵管辖区有关）；它们是历史同源词，并非由 comital 直接派生，comital 本身没有常用的现代派生词系列。
morphology_enriched.en: The word can be analyzed as comit-, a bound Latin stem referring to a count, + -al “relating to.” Related words include count, countess, and county, historically associated with a count's jurisdiction; these are historical relatives rather than direct derivatives of comital, which has no common modern derivative series.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: of a count（伯爵的）是直接释义；of an earl（英国伯爵的）用于相应英国爵位；aristocratic（贵族的）范围更广，不限定伯爵等级。comital 主要见于历史学、纹章学和贵族制度研究。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Of a count is a direct paraphrase; of an earl applies to the corresponding British title; aristocratic is broader and does not specify this rank. Comital occurs chiefly in historical, heraldic, and peerage-related writing.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: “同伴、随从”发展为伯爵称号；comit- + -al 就是“伯爵的”。
mnemonic_anchor.en: A ruler's companion became a count: comit- plus -al means “relating to that count.”

senses.meaning_zh: 胶束；两亲性分子在液体中自组装形成的聚集体
senses.meaning_en: an aggregate formed by the self-assembly of amphiphilic molecules in a liquid
senses.english_definition: A micelle is a small group of molecules, such as soap molecules, that arrange themselves in a liquid so that their different parts interact differently with the surrounding liquid.
senses.collocation_en: micelle formation; a spherical micelle
senses.collocation_zh: 胶束形成；球形胶束
senses.sentence_en: In water, soap molecules can form micelles with their water-repelling tails directed inward.
senses.sentence_zh: 在水中，肥皂分子可以形成疏水尾部朝内的胶束。

etymology_story.zh: 最终源自拉丁语 micella（小碎屑），它是 mica（碎屑）的指小形式。这个表示“小颗粒”的词进入科学术语后，后来用于描述胶体体系中的分子聚集体，包括表面活性剂形成的胶束。
etymology_story.en: The word ultimately derives from Latin micella, “a small crumb,” a diminutive of mica, “crumb.” After entering scientific terminology for tiny particles, it came to describe molecular aggregates in colloidal systems, including those formed by surfactants.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语以 micelle 为词基：micelle → micellar（胶束的）；micell- + -ization／-isation → micellization／micellisation（胶束化）；micell- + -ize／-ise → micellize／micellise（形成胶束，专业用语）。复数为 micelles；历史上的 mica + 指小后缀属于拉丁语构词，不是现代英语的生产性拆分。
morphology_enriched.en: Modern English uses micelle as the base: micelle → micellar “relating to micelles”; micell- + -ization/-isation → micellization/micellisation; and micell- + -ize/-ise → micellize/micellise, technical verbs meaning to form micelles. The plural is micelles; the historical mica-plus-diminutive formation belongs to Latin rather than productive modern English morphology.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: molecular aggregate（分子聚集体）和 colloidal aggregate（胶体聚集体）都是较宽泛的相关表达，不能精确替代 micelle；vesicle（囊泡）则是不同结构，通常具有包围内部空间的膜。典型水溶液胶束具有疏水核心，而非这种膜包围的内部空间。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Molecular aggregate and colloidal aggregate are broader related expressions rather than exact substitutes for micelle. A vesicle is a different structure, typically with a membrane enclosing an internal compartment; a typical aqueous micelle instead has a hydrophobic core.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: 把胶束想成一个“小分子团”：在水中，亲水头朝外，疏水尾藏内。
mnemonic_anchor.en: Picture a tiny molecular cluster in water: water-loving heads face out, while water-repelling tails hide inside.

etymology_story.zh: 借自拉丁语 sēdērunt，意为“他们坐下了”，是 sedēre“坐”的完成时第三人称复数形式。这个原用于记录到会者的词后来成为英语名词，表示正式会议及其出席记录。
etymology_story.en: The word comes from Latin sēdērunt, meaning “they sat,” the third-person plural perfect of sedēre, “to sit.” Used in recording attendance, it became an English noun for a formal sitting and its attendance record.

morphology_enriched.zh: 现代英语中是整体借入的名词，不能分析为能产的英语词根加后缀；复数为 sederunts。历史上的拉丁语结构是 sēd-（“坐”的完成时词干）+ -ērunt（完成时主动直陈式第三人称复数词尾）；没有常用的英语派生词族。
morphology_enriched.en: In modern English, sederunt is an unanalyzed borrowed noun rather than a productive English root-and-suffix formation; its plural is sederunts. Historically, the Latin structure is sēd-, the perfect stem meaning “sat,” plus -ērunt, the third-person plural perfect active indicative ending; there is no common English derivative family.

synonyms_and_nuances.zh: sitting（一次正式开会）最接近其会议义；session（会议或会期）适用范围更广；attendance list（出席名单）只对应其记录义。sederunt 带有明显的苏格兰司法、教会或历史文献色彩。
synonyms_and_nuances.en: Sitting is the closest equivalent for a formal meeting; session applies more broadly to meetings and periods of business; attendance list matches only the record sense. Sederunt has a distinctly Scottish legal, ecclesiastical, or historical association.

mnemonic_anchor.zh: “他们坐下了”→正式开会→记下谁到会。
mnemonic_anchor.en: “They sat” → a formal sitting → a record of who attended.

senses.meaning_zh: 菊石亚纲动物；已灭绝的有壳海生头足类动物
senses.meaning_en: an extinct shelled marine cephalopod belonging to the Ammonoidea
senses.english_definition: An ammonoid is an extinct sea animal belonging to a group of cephalopods that usually had a coiled, chambered shell.
senses.collocation_en: ammonoid fossils; ammonoid shells
senses.collocation_zh: 菊石类化石；菊石类的壳
senses.sentence_en: The limestone contains several well-preserved ammonoid fossils.
senses.sentence_zh: 这块石灰岩中含有数枚保存完好的菊石类化石。

senses.meaning_zh: 菊石类的；与菊石亚纲有关的
